title: Check AI answers before you trust them

sources.name: Prompting guidance: verify outputs and iterate

caption:
AI can sound confident and still be wrong. Here is a simple 5-step routine for checking an answer before you use it.
For anything important, confirm it with official or primary sources yourself.
Save this checklist. Comment CHECK and I will send it.

slides.headline: Confident is not correct
body: AI can state wrong facts in a smooth, convincing tone.

slides.headline: Ask what it is unsure about
body: This surfaces weak spots worth checking.
slides.prompt: Which parts of your answer are you least certain about? List them and say what I should verify.

slides.headline: Open the real sources
body: Do not rely on a link you have not opened.
Check that the page really says it.

slides.headline: Cross-check the numbers
body: Compare figures and dates with an official or primary source.

slides.headline: Ask for the other side
body: Look for gaps, exceptions and reasons it might be wrong.
slides.prompt: What is the strongest argument against your answer? What exceptions or missing context should I know about?

slides.headline: Check how recent it is
body: Look for the date on the source.

slides.headline: Use an expert instead
body: For health, legal or money decisions, ask a qualified professional.

slides.headline: Ask, open, compare, challenge
body: Four quick habits catch most mistakes.

slides.headline: Save this checking routine
body: Comment CHECK and I will send the checklist.
Share this with someone who copies AI answers directly.
